title: Astra's Recovery Heart Drops
description: Hostile mobs sometimes drop Hearts, which instantly restore health upon pickup!
body:
# DESCRIPTION

This simple datapack makes it so hostile mobs killed by the player have a chance (20%, increasing by 5% for each level of looting, to be precise.) to drop a Recovery Heart, which, when picked up, instantly heals two of your hearts. This is useful for if you're getting swarmed by enemies and need a quick heal or two. There's not much more to this datapack, so have fun!

### OTHER THINGS

There is a required resource pack for this datapack, please be sure to download it as well!

This datapack was made for version 26.1.2.

**Being a loot table datapack, this may have difficulty running with other datapacks that involve altering mob drops. Use at your own risk.** Compatibility will remain ensured with other datapacks made by myself, unless otherwise stated.
